usageNotes: Use this to update an existing automated-installer access token — toggle it enabled/disabled, set or clear an expiration date, update its comment, or rotate its secret. Requires the `System.Modify` privilege on `/system/auto-installation`. If you set `regenerate-secret: true`, the response body will include the new plaintext secret — this is the only time it is retrievable, so capture it immediately.

examples.summary: Rotate the secret on the 'imaging-lab' token and extend its expiration by one year

tips: Pass `digest` (from a prior GET) to guard against concurrent edits overwriting each other.
Use the `delete` array to clear optional fields (e.g. `["comment", "expire-at"]`) rather than sending an empty string.
Setting `enabled: false` is a safe, reversible way to disable a token without deleting it while investigating suspected misuse.
A regenerated secret immediately invalidates the old one — any installer nodes still using the old secret will fail authentication until reconfigured.
